review.feedback: English draft resting on a synthetic fixture only: weekly output modelled as fair coins, every probability computed exactly as a count of equally likely coin histories and confirmed by three seeded sets of 20,000 simulated runs, with 24 self-checks that pass and output that is byte-identical on the four Python builds tried. The hypothesis and its thresholds were written before the first run and all held. The plan of 25 courses in each of 21 departments is a draft curriculum specification's figure that the pinned repository does not state (it holds 23 department records, 21 with a course folder); it serves only for scale; no weekly output of the project was read, and the thresholds belong to the assumed steady output (bursty output of the same mean makes the calibrated rules fire in most on-plan plans). Page's 1954 article was not opened; his scheme is stated as the NIST/SEMATECH handbook gives it. Human subject review, learner trial, translation and publication remain pending.
